## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tours, France. It starts at Chenonceaux.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Looking for a castle to call your own? We've got the next best thing. Visit the magical Château de Chenonceau, which has stood proudly in this spot in one form or another since the 12th century! Access the Royal Gardens, Dômes Gallery, Carriage Gallery, and of course Chenonceau Castle itself.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €22.19. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 898 ratings and 359 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
